nom: SUNDAY RILEY U.F.O. Ultra-Clarifying Acne Treatment Face Oil

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin mostly report clearer, less congested skin, though two say the oil made their already-oily nose or T-zone feel greasier and recommend limiting use to a nighttime routine.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin generally report good hydration without a greasy feel and say it does not dry their skin out further, though a couple mention new dry patches, such as under the eyes, appearing during use.
segments.combination: The one reviewer who describes combination (combo/oily/sensitive) skin uses it specifically as a spot treatment at the first sign of a breakout.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin mostly describe it as gentle and non-irritating, several saying it does not clog their skin and calms redness, while one exception reports waking up with red patches on one side of her face and had to stop.
segments.normal: The one reviewer who describes normal skin says it is usually fine day to day but reacts to hormonal flare-ups, and the oil helped calm those flare-ups.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their mid-40s to 60s report visible improvements, from reduced fine lines and wrinkles to fresher-looking skin and controlled adult or hormonal acne, with one titling her review 'it actually works on mature hormonal skin.'

concerns.aging: A small number of reviewers mention fine lines and wrinkles: one middle-aged reviewer reports them reduced, while another, whose review appears twice in the sample, says it helped her fine lines but left her already-dry skin feeling a little drier.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers who describe dry or dehydrated skin generally report the oil hydrates well without heaviness, some saying they no longer feel the need for a separate moisturizer; a couple report the opposite, developing dry patches under the eyes or feeling slightly drier despite already having dry skin.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report reduced redness and calmer-looking skin around breakouts; one reviewer with sensitive skin instead developed new red patches after use and had to stop.
concerns.barrier: Most reviewers describe the oil as gentle and non-irritating, several noting it avoids the redness or dryness other treatments cause; two reviewers had adverse reactions instead, one needing to wash it off and take an antihistamine for an allergic response, another developing red patches and stopping use, unsure which ingredient triggered it.
concerns.spots: Reviewers dealing with dark spots, hyperpigmentation and post-acne marks widely report visible fading and a more even tone within one to two weeks of consistent use, including marks around the mouth and chin; no reviewer in this sample reports spots getting worse.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with acne-prone or blemish-prone skin, including several describing cystic or hormonal jawline acne, report clearer skin with fewer blackheads, whiteheads and breakouts within one to several weeks; however, three reviewers say it did nothing for their acne or made it and their blackheads worse, and one notes it faded her dark spots but 'not so much my acne.'
concerns.oiliness: A few reviewers with oily skin or oily zones say the oil feels too rich there, making the nose or T-zone greasier or feeling too heavy to wear under morning makeup, and suggest limiting use to a nighttime routine; most other reviewers instead describe the texture as lightweight and non-greasy.

aspects.libelle: Premium glass bottle and dropper packaging
Small amount needed, bottle lasts months
Too rich to wear under morning makeup

extraits.texte: Did nothing for my acne. May have made acne and blackheads worse. Stopped using this - changing nothing else in my routine - and skin instantly improved. I love the Good Genes and CEO Glow. Sadly, UFO did not work for my cystic acne prone skin.

I really loved the way this looked & felt on my skin. I wanted to keep using it but i think i just have really sensitive skin bc i kept waking up to red patches on my right side after using it the night before so i had to stop using it. I really liked it besides that , it made my skin glow , made my pores look smaller but my skin is just more on the sensitive side to whatever ingredient caused it 🥲

I have been using the Sunday Riley U.F.O. Ultra Clarifying Treatment Face Oil for 2 weeks now, and I must say, it has been a game-changer for my dry skin with clogged pores! As someone who has struggled with dullness, dark spots, and stubborn blackheads, this product delivered impressive results that left me pleasantly surprised. First and foremost, the face oil deeply nourished my parched skin, providing a much-needed boost of hydration that lasted throughout the day. It didn't feel greasy or heavy, which was a relief, as I often worry about using oils on my already dry skin. The lightweight texture allowed it to absorb quickly, leaving my skin feeling supple and soft. The most remarkable transformation was in the brightness of my complexion. After consistent use, I noticed a significant improvement in my skin's radiance. Those pesky dark spots that had been bothering me for ages gradually faded, making my skin look more even-toned and youthful. Furthermore, the face oil worked wonders on my stubborn blackheads. It seemed to unclog my pores and prevent new blackheads from forming, leaving my skin smoother and clearer over time. However, the one drawback I encountered was the overwhelming smell of the product. The strong fragrance lingered for quite some time, which may not sit well with those sensitive to scents. extraits.titre: Great but not for oily skin types
extraits.texte: I used this product gifted by sunday Riley for over a week and have found that it's probably not best for my skin type on certain areas of my face, it's an oil based product and my nose tends to be too oily already so specifically there, the product could make my nose more clogged because it couldn't take such an oily product on it as well, however in the areas of my face that are dryer, like my cheeks and forehead, this worked really well as a nighttime moisturiser. It also helped well with my darker spots on both my face, and my underarms where I was also applying it. I struggle with discolouration and I do think from what I can see it does help with that a lot.

extraits.titre: Best Product I've Found For Adult Acne
extraits.texte: I am in my 30's and have struggled with cystic hormonal jawline acne and blackheads in the last 5 years. I have tried so many expensive products, supplements, facial treatments, masques etc. nothing seemed to make much of a difference. It took me about two months to see it entirely clear, but I don't even notice breakouts on my cycle anymore and my blackheads haven't been this clear in years. It smells kind of weird but doesn't dry out my sensitive skin at all and I use it daily! Highly recommend!

extraits.titre: Extremely Gentle Yet Does As It Says
extraits.texte: When first using it, the colour and smell surprised me a little. You can tell it has black seed oil in, which is known to be a great healing property in regards to everything - so that gave me quite a bit of hope for my skin. The idea that it was an exfoliating oil really intrigued me as I struggle with an extremely oily t-zone and some blackheads/whiteheads on my nose. Upon application, it did feel extremely light on my skin. I have used this product for a week straight and can confidently say my skin has 1000% improved. I did notice that it got worse (day 2/3) before it got better (day 6/7); my hyperpigmentation improved greatly - I struggle with this mainly around my mouth and it has lightened considerably - and my nose definitely feels and looks a lot smoother. It definitely did exfoliate my skin in a gentle way, meaning I won't be having to use my harsh exfoliators anymore. There is also a lot of product in the packaging, and a little goes a long way - there's barely a dent in mine - so it will for sure last you a long time. This product was gifted by Sunday Riley; this review is 100% true as I have tried and tested it for a week (and will continue to use it).

So I have received this product a week ago Complimentary from Sunday Riley and have been using it ever since. My daughter usually does skin care for me as she loves skincare and uses it daily. I am a middle aged man and I have seen that my fine lines and wrinkles have been reduced, my skin feels soft and very hydrated. This product has helped my skin a lot. I usually have dry skin and it gets irritated a lot, my skin is sensitive and this product has actually helped my skin. I can see an improvement and I recommend this product.
